verses.t: “Sattime, bhikkhave, saddhammā. Katame satta? Saddho hoti, hirīmā hoti, ottappī hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, satimā hoti, paññavā hoti. Ime kho, bhikkhave, satta saddhammā”ti. Dasamaṁ. Samaṇavaggo navamo.
Bhikkhuṁ samaṇo brāhmaṇo, sottiyo ceva nhātako; Vedagū ariyo arahā, asaddhammā ca saddhammāti.
